name: CSS Stalwart
note: R13.35, Captain's Module R4 SSD p.74 (PDF p.75). The Frigate hull with a leader's extras: command rating 4 rather than 3, shields 20 all round rather than 16, a SECOND APR and a SECOND AUX CON, and ONE plasma-G forward where the FF carries two plasma-F. Warp, centre hull, shuttles, impulse, batteries and every damage track match the FF exactly. Like the DDL it has NO PROBES -- no PRB box on the hull and no probes table on the sheet, where the FF has both; the ISC appear to spend the small leaders' probe on their improved capabilities, since the DDL pays the same price. Recorded here BECAUSE it is unusual: an absent probe reads exactly like a copy-paste oversight, and this file WAS copied from the FF. Lined with the FF, as the DDL is lined with the DD. No refit deductions on the sheet, so the point value of 83 is the hull as built; the Y180 Sabot refit (+1) is absent as elsewhere, FP11.0 being in Module R10, out of scope. The sheet also carries a T-BOMBS table (2 real, 2 dummy) which is not recorded, because no ship file in this repo records one -- see auxiliary.tBombs.
